narrative.overview:
The interface is composed like a living visual score: expressive display lettering shares the frame with cinematic imagery, precise labels, sequence counts, crosshairs, and a single active signal. Ink-dark surfaces hold soft-white reading type; gold marks the moments that need emphasis. The result is contemporary and digital-first, not a generic portfolio shell.

The score language recurs in selection controls, fine rules, and live-style annotations. Images are treated as authored material: subdued with restrained grayscale/sepia filters, overlaid with a legible caption and disclosure, and kept in sync with their selected notes. Across the site, editorial type gives way to clear sans-serif reading and compact monospaced metadata; the visual devices remain functional, not ornamental.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black planes with warm, soft-white type and layered gold signals.
Oversized, tightly tracked display lettering paired with precise monospaced notation.
Image-led compositions organized by fine rules, numbered cues, and active-state markers.
Square-edged controls and cards, with circular forms reserved for signal dots.

rules.name: The Gold Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep gold legible as a hierarchy of signals: actions, active states, selected words, and score markers—not a blanket surface color.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep display statements, readable body copy, and monospaced score metadata distinct; do not flatten these jobs into one type voice.

rules.name: The Signal-Bloom Rule
rules.body: Keep glow attached to a live marker or status dot; use tonal surfaces and hairlines—not broad shadows—to separate content planes.

dos: Do use the ink/soft-white foundation with the existing tiered gold signal roles.
Do pair Bricolage display type with IBM Plex Sans reading copy and IBM Plex Mono annotations.
Do use hairlines, tonal ink planes, and restrained marker glow to create depth.
Do keep image captions, disclosures, and selection cues attached to the visual they describe.
donts: Don't steer the world toward retro film-stock or vintage production motifs; the chosen treatment is contemporary and digital-first.
Don't promote a concept frame or image into an unqualified factual claim; the shipped interface uses explicit concept disclosure.
